title: compile.ts: SymbolInstance with colorEffect+instanceName drops the name from PlaceObject2
description: In compile.ts ~line 1742, when a SymbolInstance has both colorEffect (non-null cxform) AND instanceName, the code calls encodePlaceObject2WithCXForm() which has no name parameter — HasName flag 0x20 is never set, instance name is silently dropped. Fix: add instanceName support to the CXForm PlaceObject2 path (set flag 0x2E when name is also present). Also audit the clip-actions+colorEffect combined case at ~line 1722. All AS2 references to color-effected named instances are silently broken.
